task.title: M5: Compare view: delta treemap, edge changes, and biggest-changes table
task.description:
Build the compare view. It reuses the treemap with area = code lines in head and a diverging color by delta (added, removed, grown, shrunk files), overlays the dependency graph with added edges and removed edges styled distinctly, and shows a sortable table of the biggest changes by code, complexity, and churn delta. Two ref pickers at the top choose base and head and trigger analysis as needed.

Acceptance criteria:
- Compare route takes base and head from the URL, fetches /api/compare, and renders all three panels.
- Delta treemap uses a diverging scale with a legend; removed files are drawn in head's hierarchy at their base size with a distinct style.
- Graph panel shows added and removed edges and lets the user filter to only changed edges.
- Table sorts by each delta column and links rows to the file in the treemap.
- Works with module-level-only snapshots and is covered by a component test with a fixture diff.
